race.title: www.thurlesraces.ie Handicap Chase (0-100)
race.verdict: ONEFORTHEDITCH would have gone close but for uncharacteristic errors on her last 2 starts and can gain compensation here with a clear round of jumping. Way Down South has had issues with his jumping in the past but is well treated on his recent hurdling win and rates the main danger, while both Tantrum Boy and Gortmore Lady are also capable of being in the mix if putting their best foot forward. ONEFORTHEDITCH (IRE) WAY DOWN SOUTH (IRE) TANTRUM BOY (IRE)
